modernity.evidence: Flat design with rounded cards and pill buttons on a warm sand background; contemporary sans-serif type.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Large bold headline, short lead, then one coral button; info cards sit clearly below the hero.

mobile_usability.evidence: Mobile collapses to one column with a full-width booking button; header keeps only logo and Réserver.

readability.evidence: Dark text on cream with generous line height; body copy comfortably sized on both viewports.

imagery_quality.evidence: Illustrated beach scene with a plate and fish graphic; tidy but abstract, no real food photography.

trust_signals.evidence: Five gold stars with 4,8/5 and 320 reviews, "depuis 2009", plus hours, address and phone cards.

cta_clarity.evidence: Coral "Réserver une table" button in the hero, repeated as a "Réserver" button in the header.

brand_consistency.evidence: Teal and coral logo colors reused in headings, buttons and the illustration throughout.

summary.en: Modern, well-structured restaurant homepage with a prominent booking button, visible reviews and a clean mobile layout. Only the illustrated hero lacks real food photos.
summary.fr: Page d'accueil moderne et bien structurée, avec un bouton de réservation très visible, des avis affichés et une version mobile propre. Seule l'illustration remplace de vraies photos des plats.

modernity.evidence: Full-bleed gradient hero with a large light headline and a spaced uppercase kicker; minimal layout.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Kicker, headline, subline and white button stack clearly; the stats row below is easy to scan.

mobile_usability.evidence: Hero text and a full-width "Check availability" button fit the phone; nav links hidden with no menu icon.

readability.evidence: White text over the gradient reads well, though the spaced-out uppercase kicker is small.

imagery_quality.evidence: Hero is an abstract gradient with a sun circle; no photos of the villa or pool are visible.

trust_signals.evidence: 4.9 star rating from 146 stays, a quoted guest review, "since 2012" and a contact line.

cta_clarity.evidence: High-contrast white "Check availability" button with a secondary "View rates" link.

brand_consistency.evidence: Teal palette and spaced wordmark carried from the hero into the stats numbers.

summary.en: Clean, modern villa page with a strong availability CTA and clear key facts. It relies on an abstract gradient instead of real photos of the property.
summary.fr: Page de villa moderne et épurée, avec un appel à l'action clair pour les disponibilités et des chiffres clés lisibles. Elle utilise un dégradé abstrait au lieu de vraies photos de la propriété.

modernity.evidence: Dark theme with a rounded hero card, pill badge and bold sans-serif headline; current design.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Headline with yellow accent words draws the eye, then primary and secondary buttons side by side.

mobile_usability.evidence: On mobile the hero stacks, buttons go full width and the trust line becomes a vertical list.

readability.evidence: Light text on navy is legible; the trust line under the hero is smaller and lower contrast.

imagery_quality.evidence: Sunset sea illustration with a sailboat silhouette; clean and on-theme, though not a photo.

trust_signals.evidence: Gold stars with 4.9 from 410 reviews, "Licensed skipper · Since 2011", departure times and phone.

cta_clarity.evidence: Yellow "Book now" in the header and a large "Book a trip — from €95" button in the hero.

brand_consistency.evidence: Navy and amber used consistently for the logo dot, accents, buttons and stars.

summary.en: Polished dark-themed charter page with an obvious booking path, price anchor and strong social proof. Works well on mobile.
summary.fr: Page de location de bateau soignée, au thème sombre, avec un parcours de réservation évident, un prix d'appel et des avis bien mis en avant. Fonctionne bien sur mobile.

modernity.evidence: Arched image frame and serif headline feel calm and current, but the overall layout is fairly plain.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Centered wordmark and nav, then headline and button; the large arch image competes for attention.

mobile_usability.evidence: Mobile stacks the arch image above the text with a full-width button; the image takes much of the screen.

readability.evidence: Large serif headline and sans-serif body in muted brown on cream; comfortable text sizes.

imagery_quality.evidence: Arch is a beige gradient with a single leaf drawing; pleasant but no photos of the treatment rooms.

trust_signals.evidence: Gold stars with 4,9 and 210 reviews, opening hours, "Depuis 2015" and an address with phone.

cta_clarity.evidence: Brown uppercase "Prendre rendez-vous" button is clear but lacks contrast against the beige palette.

brand_consistency.evidence: Muted brown and beige palette and the serif wordmark are applied consistently.

summary.en: Calm, coherent spa homepage with visible reviews and a booking button. The CTA is understated and the imagery is a simple illustration.
summary.fr: Page d'accueil de spa apaisante et cohérente, avec des avis visibles et un bouton de rendez-vous. L'appel à l'action reste discret et le visuel se limite à une illustration simple.

modernity.evidence: Rounded green hero panel, soft cards and bold sans-serif type; clean contemporary style.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Headline and yellow button lead the hero; class schedule cards follow in a clear row.

mobile_usability.evidence: Single-column hero with a full-width button and two-column class cards; menu links are hidden.

readability.evidence: White on deep green and dark text on pale green are both clear; schedule labels are small.

imagery_quality.evidence: Hero art is a simple figure drawing over circles; illustrative, with no studio photography.

trust_signals.evidence: Star rating with 180 reviews and "Teaching since 2016" appear only in a small line near the bottom.

cta_clarity.evidence: Yellow "Book your first class — €15" button stands out against the dark green panel.

brand_consistency.evidence: Green and yellow palette from the logo dot repeats across the hero, cards and stars.

summary.en: Modern, friendly yoga studio page with a clear first-class offer and visible schedule. Trust signals are present but small.
summary.fr: Page de studio de yoga moderne et accueillante, avec une offre de premier cours claire et un planning visible. Les éléments de confiance sont présents mais discrets.

modernity.evidence: Fixed-width centered box with a brown header bar and three floated columns; mid-2000s template look.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Banner text "Bienvenue sur notre site internet !" is the focal point; no headline about the products.

mobile_usability.evidence: On mobile the fixed-width page overflows: the banner text and second product column are cut off at the right edge.

readability.evidence: Small Verdana body text in grey; legible on desktop but cramped inside bordered columns.

imagery_quality.evidence: Simple bread, croissant and cake drawings in beige boxes; tidy but generic.

trust_signals.evidence: Opening hours and phone in a tiny footer; no reviews or founding year visible.

cta_clarity.evidence: Only small "En savoir plus »" and "Commander »" text links; ordering is described as phone only.

brand_consistency.evidence: Brown palette is consistent across the header, menu and column headings.

summary.en: Functional but dated bakery site: fixed-width layout that is cut off on mobile, small text and no clear call to action. The brown palette is consistent.
summary.fr: Site de boulangerie fonctionnel mais daté : largeur fixe coupée sur mobile, petits textes et aucun appel à l'action clair. La palette brune reste cohérente.

modernity.evidence: Plain blue header bar, underlined nav links and a bordered price table; dated but tidy.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: "Welcome to Island Wheels" heading, car drawing, then text and price table read in a logical order.

mobile_usability.evidence: On mobile the layout stacks into one readable column with full-width form inputs.

readability.evidence: Body text and the price table are clearly sized with good contrast on white.

imagery_quality.evidence: Flat red car drawing on a sky and road background; simple placeholder-like art.

trust_signals.evidence: Phone in the header, hours and address in the footer; no reviews or ratings shown.

cta_clarity.evidence: "Request a quote" form is visible but its grey "Send" button is small and low-emphasis.

brand_consistency.evidence: Blue header and headings are consistent; the logo is plain bold text.

summary.en: Clear, usable rental page with visible prices and a quote form that adapts well to mobile. The visual style is plain and the call to action is weak.
summary.fr: Page de location claire et utilisable, avec des tarifs visibles et un formulaire de devis qui s'adapte bien au mobile. Le style reste basique et l'appel à l'action est faible.

modernity.evidence: Table-based page with a gradient header, left link sidebar and dotted separators; looks 2000s.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Header and "Bienvenue au cabinet" heading are clear, but the content is a short block of text.

mobile_usability.evidence: The wide table is scaled down on the phone; text is tiny and most of the screen is empty blue-grey.

readability.evidence: Dark text on white is clear on desktop, but the font is small with tight line spacing.

imagery_quality.evidence: Only a small tooth drawing in a pale box; no photos of the practice or the team.

trust_signals.evidence: Practitioner names, hours, phone and address in a highlighted box, plus "Conventionné secteur 1".

cta_clarity.evidence: No booking button; text says appointments are by phone only, with the number inside the info box.

brand_consistency.evidence: Blue gradient header and link colors are consistent but generic.

summary.en: Informative but dated practice site: useful hours and contact details, yet a table layout that is tiny on mobile and no way to book online.
summary.fr: Site de cabinet informatif mais daté : horaires et coordonnées utiles, mais une mise en page en tableau minuscule sur mobile et aucune prise de rendez-vous en ligne.

modernity.evidence: Slider-style hero with arrow glyphs and a caption box, then three bordered cards; common older template.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Caption sits small in a dark box; the cards below have equal weight with no primary focus.

mobile_usability.evidence: Mobile hides the nav and stacks the cards; the slider shrinks and its caption stays readable.

readability.evidence: Clear sans-serif text with good contrast; card text sizes are adequate.

imagery_quality.evidence: Hero is a plain teal gradient and the three card images are empty pale green rectangles.

trust_signals.evidence: Phone, e-mail and address in the footer; no ratings, reviews or stars shown.

cta_clarity.evidence: No booking button; only small underlined links such as "Voir les chambres" and an e-mail in the footer.

brand_consistency.evidence: Gold rule and serif wordmark echo the brown headings; restrained, consistent palette.

summary.en: Generic hotel template with readable text and a consistent palette, but empty image blocks and no booking button.
summary.fr: Modèle d'hôtel générique, avec un texte lisible et une palette cohérente, mais des emplacements d'images vides et aucun bouton de réservation.

modernity.evidence: Pink header bar with a plain centered title, pipe-separated nav and a single bordered content box; dated.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Large title and "Bienvenue au salon !" heading lead into a price list with little visual emphasis.

mobile_usability.evidence: On mobile the fixed-width box overflows; the heading, prices and booking link are cut off at the right edge.

readability.evidence: Grey 12–13px text on white; the price list is readable on desktop but small.

imagery_quality.evidence: Pink gradient panel with a scissors drawing; generic, no photos of hairstyles or the salon.

trust_signals.evidence: Hours, phone and address only in a small grey footer line; no reviews.

cta_clarity.evidence: Only an underlined pink link "Prendre rendez-vous par téléphone" below the price list.

brand_consistency.evidence: Pink is used consistently for the header, links and headings.

summary.en: Dated single-box salon page with useful prices and a consistent pink theme, but it is cut off on mobile and offers only a phone-booking link.
summary.fr: Page de salon datée, en un seul bloc, avec des tarifs utiles et un thème rose cohérent, mais coupée sur mobile et limitée à un lien de réservation par téléphone.

modernity.evidence: Neon green, magenta, cyan and orange blocks with a fake ticker line and a visitor counter; 1990s look.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: A shouting "BIENVENUE" banner dominates; content is one long paragraph between colored side bars.

mobile_usability.evidence: Fixed wide layout with no mobile adaptation; on the phone everything is shrunk and tiny.

readability.evidence: Grey-olive text on pale yellow and orange on orange are very low contrast; no paragraph breaks.

imagery_quality.evidence: Two dashed grey boxes reading "[ image introuvable ]" instead of photos.

trust_signals.evidence: Only a phone number in the orange sidebar; "site en construction" and the visitor counter hurt trust.

cta_clarity.evidence: No button or booking action; menu items are plain dashed text.

brand_consistency.evidence: Clashing neon colors and mixed sans-serif, serif and monospace fonts with no coherent identity.

summary.en: Very poor, cluttered page: clashing neon colors, unreadable text, broken image placeholders, an "under construction" notice and no way to book.
summary.fr: Page très faible et surchargée : couleurs fluo criardes, texte illisible, images manquantes, mention « en construction » et aucun moyen de réserver.

modernity.evidence: Dark purple page with ridged table borders, a letter-spaced red title and striped placeholder boxes.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: The large red title is clear, but below it the content is a dense table with no headings.

mobile_usability.evidence: Wide fixed page scaled onto the phone; text is microscopic and most of the screen is empty purple.

readability.evidence: Dim purple text on dark purple is nearly invisible; one long run-on paragraph in small serif.

imagery_quality.evidence: Three striped boxes labelled with file names like "image.jpg" instead of villa photos.

trust_signals.evidence: Shows "page last updated 03/2011" and "under construction"; only an e-mail address is visible.

cta_clarity.evidence: Tiny blue "click here" links next to a red "NEW!! SPECIAL OFFER" label; no booking button.

brand_consistency.evidence: Red title, bright green subtitle and dim serif body clash with no consistent palette.

summary.en: Outdated, nearly unreadable villa page with placeholder images, an old update date and no clear booking path. Unusable on mobile.
summary.fr: Page de villa obsolète et presque illisible, avec des images factices, une date de mise à jour ancienne et aucun parcours de réservation. Inutilisable sur mobile.

modernity.evidence: Rainbow gradient header on saturated blue, an "UNDER CONSTRUCTION" banner and a row of ASCII fish.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Header and construction banner dominate; the actual offer is a small line under broken images.

mobile_usability.evidence: Fixed wide layout shrinks on the phone; the text below the images becomes unreadable.

readability.evidence: Dark grey and blue serif text on a bright blue background is barely visible.

imagery_quality.evidence: Four white boxes reading "X broken image" and "[photo coming soon]".

trust_signals.evidence: Phone number is buried in low-contrast text next to "no refunds"; no reviews or address.

cta_clarity.evidence: No button; the only action is "call" inside a hard-to-read sentence.

brand_consistency.evidence: Rainbow, blue, yellow and green clash; the header font differs from the serif and monospace text.

summary.en: Unfinished-looking charter page: garish colors, broken image boxes, an under-construction banner and barely visible text with no clear action.
summary.fr: Page de sorties en mer qui semble inachevée : couleurs criardes, images cassées, bandeau « en construction » et texte à peine visible, sans action claire.

modernity.evidence: Orange and lime color bars with stacked mismatched fonts; looks like an old hand-built page.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Big green title and pink product banner are clear, followed by a row of placeholder tiles.

mobile_usability.evidence: Fixed wide layout is shrunk on the phone; the three-column text becomes tiny and most of the screen is empty.

readability.evidence: Light tan monospace text on peach in three justified columns is hard to read.

imagery_quality.evidence: Six grey dotted tiles labelled "photo_produit_1" to "photo_produit_6" instead of product photos.

trust_signals.evidence: Phone and e-mail in a red footer bar, but the "site en construction" notice is prominent.

cta_clarity.evidence: No shop or visit button; the footer only lists contact details.

brand_consistency.evidence: Orange and lime are bold but clash with pink and red; sans-serif headings differ from the monospace body.

summary.en: Cluttered souvenir shop page with clashing colors, placeholder product tiles and hard-to-read text. Contact details exist but there is no clear action.
summary.fr: Page de boutique de souvenirs surchargée, aux couleurs criardes, avec des vignettes produits factices et un texte difficile à lire. Les coordonnées sont là mais sans action claire.

modernity.evidence: Grey table grid with black cell borders and a navy title bar; looks like an unstyled 1990s page.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Red all-caps service list shouts; the rest is one dense paragraph and bare text cells for navigation.

mobile_usability.evidence: Fixed-width table is scaled down to the phone width; the text is very small.

readability.evidence: Navy-on-navy title is almost unreadable; grey body text on grey cells is low contrast.

imagery_quality.evidence: Grey cells labelled "[logo]", "[photo camion]" and an empty box instead of images.

trust_signals.evidence: Phone and fax numbers in the footer and "20 ans d'experience" in the text, but "page en construction".

cta_clarity.evidence: No button and no quote form; navigation is plain text in table cells.

brand_consistency.evidence: No logo, only a barely visible title and red shouting text on grey.

summary.en: Bare, low-contrast table page with placeholder images and shouting text. Contact numbers are present but there is no clear action or brand.
summary.fr: Page en tableau brute et peu contrastée, avec des images factices et un texte en majuscules criardes. Les numéros sont présents mais sans action claire ni identité visuelle.
